name: Kuga Mitsuki
source:
A 2nd year student belonging to "The Roses in Full Bloom" class.

Mitsuki is a 2nd year student of "The Roses in Full Bloom" class whose extraordinary beauty catches everyone's eye. She is Shin'ichi's younger sister. Her exceptional good looks, combined with her eccentric speech and conduct, possess a bewitching allure that has aggressively seized the hearts of many male students. Her fanatical admirers call her "Princess" as they revere her from afar. It appears that Mitsuki is infatuated with Takamine Riku. However, at the moment, her approaches to him haven't been successful.

[Translation of her official website character profile.]
